mapper.sql: select warehouse_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, manager_id, manager_name, phone, address, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wm_warehouse
mapper.select:
AND warehouse_code like concat('%', #{warehouseCode}, '%')
AND warehouse_name like concat('%', #{warehouseName}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into wm_warehouse (warehouse_code, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, manager_id, manager_name, phone, address, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{warehouseType}, #{managerId}, #{managerName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update wm_warehouse set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
